changelog: Boards scroll sideways while a card is dragged near their left or right edge, so an off-screen stage can be reached in one drag (#3662). Rule in `src/lib/dragAutoScrollRule.ts`, applied by `HorizontalScrollArea`.

en: Dragging a card to the edge of a board now scrolls the board, so you can drop it on a stage that was off-screen.
tr: Bir kartı panonun kenarına sürüklediğinizde pano kendiliğinden kayıyor; ekranda görünmeyen aşamaya tek hamlede bırakabilirsiniz.
de: Wenn Sie eine Karte an den Rand eines Boards ziehen, scrollt das Board mit – so erreichen Sie auch Phasen außerhalb des sichtbaren Bereichs.
